description: This file defines the NamedExpressions class responsible for writing named expressions and ranges into an ODS spreadsheet file. It handles conversion of formulas and ranges for export, interfacing closely with the PhpSpreadsheet library's objects and internal calculations.

classes.name: NamedExpressions
classes.description: Handles writing named expressions and ranges into an ODS spreadsheet, including formula conversion and address formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NamedExpressions object with writer, spreadsheet, and formula converter dependencies.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates the XML for named expressions and ranges in the ODS file.

methods.name: writeExpressions
methods.description: Iterates over defined names in the spreadsheet and writes each as a named expression or range.

methods.name: writeNamedFormula
methods.description: Writes a named formula to the XML with proper attributes, including converted formula expression.

methods.name: writeNamedRange
methods.description: Writes a named range, including its base cell address and range address.

methods.name: convertAddress
methods.description: Converts a cell reference or range address to the appropriate format, adjusting worksheet and cell references as needed.
